# Identify the row for "Deaths In Prisons & Camps" and "Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps"
prison_camp_row = df[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths In Prisons & Camps']
outside_row = df[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps']

# Extract the 'Total' column values for each
prison_camp_total = prison_camp_row['Total'].values[0]
outside_total = outside_row['Total'].values[0]

# Compare the totals
if prison_camp_total > outside_total:
    answer = 'Deaths In Prisons & Camps'
elif outside_total > prison_camp_total:
    answer = 'Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps'
else:
    answer = 'Equal'
